description: The signed-in couple's own wedding events on Zola: change the name, type, day, times, venue and address, attire, note for guests, or RSVPs of 1 event. Get the event_id from zola_list_my_wedding_events. Give only the fields to change: an empty text clears an optional field, for example note "". The day and the times are the local clock time at the place of the event: never convert them to another time zone. A new day or start time keeps the length of the event. A new address1 with no address2 clears the address2. If the website is published, guests see the change at once. Zola sends no message to the guests. A new day for the ceremony or the reception does not change the wedding date of the account. It cannot change who sees the event (on_website of the read): the couple changes that on zola.com. An event whose venue is a vendor booked on Zola changes on zola.com only. This tool cannot remove an event. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

address1.description: The street address of the venue. A new address1 with no address2 clears the old address2. An empty text clears it

address2.description: The second line of the street address, for example a suite. An empty text clears it

attire.description: The attire, for example "Cocktail attire". An empty text clears it

city.description: The city of the venue. An empty text clears it

collects_rsvps.description: True when guests can RSVP to the event on the website

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

country_code.description: The country of the venue, 2 letters, for example US. An empty text clears it

date.description: The new day, YYYY-MM-DD, at the place of the event. The event keeps its start time and its length

end_time.description: The end time, HH:MM in 24 hours, the local clock time at the place of the event. An end time before the start is on the next day. Not the start time. An empty text clears it

event_id.description: The event_id of an event from zola_list_my_wedding_events

name.description: The new name of the event

note.description: The note for guests on the website. An empty text clears it

postal_code.description: The postal code of the venue. An empty text clears it

start_time.description: The new start time, HH:MM in 24 hours, the local clock time at the place of the event. Never convert it. The event keeps its length

state_province.description: The state or province of the venue, for example TX. An empty text clears it

type.description: The new type of the event

venue_name.description: The name of the venue. An empty text clears it

name: zola_update_my_wedding_event

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change of an event of the wedding of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the wedding events

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_wedding_event with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The events with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_list_my_wedding_events gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: The fields whose value the change overwrites or clears

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Update My Wedding Event
